# Third-party UI assets, pinned by version and SHA-384.
# Format: <file> <sha384-base64> <upstream url>
# Re-download with `make vendor`; check the tracked copies with `make vendor-verify`.

# chart.js 4.4.1 and js-yaml 4.1.0 are MIT (LICENSE-chart.js.txt, LICENSE-js-yaml.txt).
# The nine d3 modules are ISC (LICENSE-d3.txt) at the versions d3 7.9.0 pins.
# Their UMD builds each merge into one shared `d3` global, so index.html loads
# them in dependency order.
